title: Konda language (Papuan)
extract: Konda is the northwesternmost of the South Bird's Head languages, spoken in Indonesia, on the island of New Guinea. It is spoken by approximately 1,500 people in the Konda District of the Sorong Selatan Regency, and is considered "endangered" by Ethnologue.
